violated_contract: A latency-sensitive live STT lane sharing GPU batch capacity with historical work must not let backfill queue depth or processing order deny healthy live admissions or delay fresh windows indefinitely.
canonical_prevention: Mark live requests explicitly, schedule live work ahead of backfill with a bounded aged-backfill turn, expose per-replica live pressure independently of total batch pressure, and fail closed when any replica lacks fresh valid live telemetry. Retain a per-listen-process session cap measured against pod CPU and memory limits.
